architecturePattern: Event-Driven Microservices (API Gateway + Saga Orchestration + CQRS + Database-per-Service)

advantages: Loose service coupling allows new content types to be added
CQRS read model absorbs high-read traffic
disadvantages: Consistency between models requires careful saga design
MediaService introduces external dependency latency risk

components.name: Frontend
responsibilities: Student UI: course browsing, enrollment, video playback, quiz submission, progress tracking
Instructor UI: course creation, content upload, student management
Responsive design for desktop and mobile

components.name: CourseService
responsibilities: Course catalog management: create, update, publish
Content type registry: pre-recorded, live session, assignment

components.name: EnrollmentService
responsibilities: Checkout saga orchestration: reserve seat, capture payment, grant course access
Concurrency control on seat reservation to prevent over-enrollment
Publishes successful and failed enrollment events

components.name: AccessService
responsibilities: Grant/revoke student access to course content
Enforce access control on content requests

components.name: MediaService
responsibilities: CDN integration for high-throughput video delivery

components.name: ProgressService
responsibilities: Expose progress summaries for student dashboard

components.name: NotificationService
responsibilities: Send email/push notifications on enrollment confirmation, payment receipt, and new content availability

components.name: AuditService
responsibilities: Store audit events from all services
Expose audit query API for compliance and security review

components.name: EventBus
responsibilities: Buffer enrollment bursts during course launch spike
Feed CQRS read model updates to CourseSearchService

components.name: CacheLayer
responsibilities: Cache popular course listings and search results
Reduce load on CourseDB and SearchIndex during enrollment spikes

components.name: ObservabilityStack
responsibilities: Autoscaling triggers for EnrollmentService and MediaService

components.name: CourseDB
responsibilities: Course catalog write store including seat capacity

components.name: SearchIndex
responsibilities: Denormalized read model for fast course search and seat availability display

components.name: EnrollmentDB
responsibilities: Enrollment state and temporal saga state

components.name: AccessDB
responsibilities: Student-course access grants and expiry records

components.name: ProgressDB
responsibilities: Student progress records: lesson completions, quiz scores

components.name: AuditLogStore
responsibilities: Tamper-evident audit log retention for GDPR compliance

components.name: MediaStore
responsibilities: Lecture videos, slides, and downloadable course materials

components.name: CDN
responsibilities: Edge caching and delivery of video content

components.name: ExternalEmailProvider
responsibilities: Email delivery for enrollment confirmations and notifications

infrastructure.name: KubernetesCluster
infrastructure.details: All services deployed as independently scalable Kubernetes Deployments; HPA configured per service; EnrollmentService and MediaService have separate scaling policies reflecting asymmetric load profiles

infrastructure.name: ObservabilityStack
infrastructure.details: Prometheus metrics scraped per pod; Grafana dashboards; AlertManager notifies on saga failures and SLA breaches
